# ai&

ai& is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Ai& employs 5 people, founded in 2026. Headquartered in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan, with an office in Kanagawa. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Japan. Has $50M in total funding.

## About

ai& is a global AI technology company built on a simple conviction: that whoever owns and optimizes the full stack wins. By combining next-generation data center infrastructure, heterogeneous compute, and frontier model services into a single optimized platform, ai& gives enterprises and developers the performance, economics, and sovereignty that no single-layer provider can match. Founded in Japan and expanding globally, ai& is building the foundation for the AI-native future.

For more information about ai&, please follow us on LinkedIn and visit www.aiand.com.

ai& Jobs

# All Ideas, Connected.

## Come build with us.

AI is an augmentation. We believe the gains of AI can be distributed broadly, and our goal is to bring them to everyone. Providing access to the tools that help individuals and companies grow is at the core of what we do. Those who learn to work with AI in the coming years will unlock capabilities that were previously unimaginable. ai& exists to build that access.

## The problem we're solving

Infrastructure is complex, expensive, and difficult to build. Compute is scarce. Running on advanced silicon is hard. Many of the best models remain closed and proprietary. Deploying, optimizing, and training AI requires deep expertise that most teams don’t have, and shouldn’t need to build from scratch. AI can be daunting to deploy. It requires the right infrastructure and guardrails.

We are building ai& to solve this complexity.

## Values

Think big. We are building for a transformative future. We approach our work with boundless imagination and monumental goals, relentlessly pushing the boundaries of what is possible.

Enable. We are here to enable people to win. When we empower our users, our partners, and each other, we all rise together. Our ultimate goal is to build something great that elevates everyone it touches.

Build with customers first. Everything we create begins with deep understanding of our users. We ensure our technology serves real needs and delivers a meaningful, positive impact.

## Operating Philosophy

Win together, lose together. We are one unified team. When we win, we celebrate together. When we mess up, we fix it together. We back each other up, focus on the solution, and succeed as a single unit, not just a group of individuals.

Small teams, high agency. We keep teams lean to maintain agility. Individuals are empowered to make swift decisions, paired with the expectation of seamless, high-trust collaboration.

Break big problems into small problems. We tackle complex challenges by breaking them into clear, manageable steps. Momentum comes from solving small problems, fast.

Quality is a feature. We care and take pride in quality across everything we build. Whether it's the code, the design, or the infrastructure.

Use what we build. We dogfood everything. We run our products on our own infrastructure every single day, so we catch the bugs and feel the friction before our users ever do.

Find a way. We believe in finding a way to do the things that matter.

## Apply!

While we are actively hiring in the Japan, US, Canada and Singapore, we believe in meeting talent where they are. Whether you are located in the above regions, want to relocate to Japan, or want to work remote - apply!!

# Our vision

Co-founders Herbie Turner and Caleb Harris met at MIT, where they both studied computer science through undergraduate and graduate school. Caleb went on to serve as a technical expert in patent litigation, whereas Herbie built his career in machine learning and AI. Through the lenses of procurement and litigation, both saw the inefficiencies in the patent system. Proving validity or infringement required such deep technical analysis that countless inventions and billions in potential licensing revenue remained locked away.

In 2024, LLMs reached the sophistication needed to handle the scientific complexity of patent material and the ambiguity of drafting. This insight sparked Herbie and Caleb to found &AI with an early team of MIT engineers with experience from Google, Meta, and Citadel Securities. The goal was to build the system that makes patent litigation efficient and unlock new revenue opportunities for asset holders, funders, litigators, and clients alike.

As Marketing Specialist at ai&, you will build and execute the marketing engine for a company that owns the full AI stack — from data centers and compute infrastructure to inference services and a developer platform. You are marketing physical infrastructure, enterprise AI services, and a developer platform to audiences that range from CTOs evaluating inference providers to developers choosing where to deploy their next model.

You will develop and execute campaigns across digital, content, events, and partner channels that drive awareness and pipeline for ai& in Japan and globally. You will own the marketing calendar, manage content production, and build the programs that turn ai&'s technical credibility into commercial opportunity. You understand that in infrastructure, trust is earned through substance — not slogans — and your marketing reflects that.

You will work closely with the sales, PR, and developer relations teams to ensure marketing efforts are coordinated and mutually reinforcing. You will also work with leadership to develop positioning and messaging that accurately reflects ai&'s differentiation in a market that is noisy, fast-moving, and full of companies making claims they cannot back up.

- Brand & Positioning: Develop and maintain ai&'s brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, and visual identity. Ensure consistency across all channels and touchpoints. Guard the brand — ai& stands for substance and technical credibility, and every piece of marketing should reflect that.
